messages.content:
You translate a traveller's one-day trip request in Singapore into a Python program that uses the z3
solver (`import z3`) to find a schedule satisfying EVERY requirement, or prove that none exists.

Facts (times in minutes since midnight, e.g. 09:00 = 540; money in whole SGD):
Places (id | name | cost | typical duration | open-close | showtimes):
adventure_cove | Adventure Cove Waterpark | 40 | 180 | 10:00-17:00 | -
universal_studios | Universal Studios Singapore | 83 | 480 | 10:00-19:00 | -
singapore_flyer | Singapore Flyer | 40 | 45 | 10:00-22:00 | -
peranakan_museum | Peranakan Museum | 15 | 90 | 10:00-19:00 | -
buddha_tooth | Buddha Tooth Relic Temple | 0 | 45 | 07:00-17:00 | -
orchid_garden | National Orchid Garden | 15 | 60 | 08:30-19:00 | -
Travel times in minutes between places (row -> column):
adventure_cove: universal_studios 12, singapore_flyer 25, peranakan_museum 23, buddha_tooth 20, orchid_garden 25
universal_studios: adventure_cove 12, singapore_flyer 25, peranakan_museum 23, buddha_tooth 20, orchid_garden 26
singapore_flyer: adventure_cove 25, universal_studios 25, peranakan_museum 15, buddha_tooth 16, orchid_garden 25
peranakan_museum: adventure_cove 23, universal_studios 23, singapore_flyer 15, buddha_tooth 14, orchid_garden 21
buddha_tooth: adventure_cove 20, universal_studios 20, singapore_flyer 16, peranakan_museum 14, orchid_garden 22
orchid_garden: adventure_cove 25, universal_studios 26, singapore_flyer 25, peranakan_museum 21, buddha_tooth 22

Rules of the domain: a visit lasts exactly its duration (the typical one unless the traveller gives one); it must
lie within opening hours; a show may only start at one of its showtimes; visits cannot overlap and consecutive
visits need the travel time between them; must-visit places are required, optional ones may be skipped;
budget is the sum of costs of visited places.

Contract: output ONE python code block. When run, the program must print exactly one final line:
either the word UNSAT, or a JSON list of objects {"location_id": id, "start": minutes, "end": minutes}
for the visited places. Do not read input, do not use the network, do not print anything after that line.

Example of the output format only: [{"location_id": "museum", "start": 540, "end": 660}]

I'm planning a day out from 10:00 to 16:05 and budget isn't an issue at all. I absolutely have to hit up Adventure Cove Waterpark and Buddha Tooth Relic Temple. If I can squeeze them in, I'd also love to visit Universal Studios Singapore, Singapore Flyer, Peranakan Museum, and National Orchid Garden.
